objective: Identify a source-disjoint authoritative dataset that can independently test the frozen Materials Project Fe/Si phase-stability problem without redefining the target after benchmark-v1 exposure.

target_contract.name: energy_above_hull
target_contract.interpretation: Energy per atom above a phase-stability convex hull under a documented and scientifically comparable thermodynamic reference convention.

domain_requirements.comparability_rule: A field name or numerical unit match is insufficient. Calculation method, energy references, corrections, competing phases, hull construction, and structure/composition identity must be audited explicitly before values are treated as comparable.
domain_requirements.identity_rule: Candidate records must support stable structure/composition identifiers and an explicit overlap audit against the original 838 Materials Project material IDs or a scientifically justified cross-source identity mapping.

scientific_boundary: The benchmark-v1 locked test and already-exposed policy results may not be reused for source selection, policy tuning, or stopping-rule design.
The Materials Project query scope may not be widened post hoc merely to create a favorable confirmatory cohort.
A same-source or Materials Project-derived mirror may be diagnostic but cannot establish source-disjoint external validation.
Candidate screening must occur before candidate target values are used for model selection or policy evaluation.
Passing this requirement screen does not itself authorize download, model fitting, evidence upgrade, or an external-validation claim.
